lines.en: label chikaonsen2:
The mixture of cold air and hot water is one of the single most under appreciated sensations in the entire world.
lines.zh: 冷空气与热水交织的感觉，是这世上最被低估的体验之一。

lines.en: Especially for a girl who so easily gets goosebumps.
lines.zh: 对一个动不动就起鸡皮疙瘩的女孩来说，尤其如此。

lines.en: So, there she sits, watching steam rise off the surface of the water-
lines.zh: 于是，她就那么坐着，看蒸汽从水面升起——

lines.en: Counting the bumps on her arms and then submerging them until they’re gone, acutely aware of how easy it is to control certain changes in our bodies.
lines.zh: 数着手臂上的鸡皮疙瘩，再把它们沉进水里直到消失，敏锐地意识到控制身体的某些变化有多容易。

lines.en: She will undergo one more dramatic shift in that regard soon.
lines.zh: 她很快就会在这方面再经历一次剧变。

lines.en: Because roughly two hundred feet away from here lies a bath for the opposite sex, currently housing a man she has fallen helplessly in love with over the last several[school] years.
lines.zh: 因为离这儿大约两百英尺的地方，有一个异性浴池，此刻正泡着一个她在过去几个[学]年里无可救药爱上的男人。

lines.en: Or perhaps it’s more like hundreds.
lines.zh: 又或者，是几百。

lines.en: Thousands, maybe?
lines.zh: 也许几千？

lines.en: What if, by some stretch of the imagination, she’s been slowly falling in love over the course of millions of[school] years?
lines.zh: 如果放开想象，她其实已经在几百万个[学]年里慢慢坠入爱河了呢？

lines.en: And what if, by an even larger stretch of the imagination, this isn’t the first time at all?
lines.zh: 再放开想象一点，这根本就不是第一次呢？

lines.en: How many onsen tickets have there been?
lines.zh: 到底有过多少张温泉票？

lines.en: And what has happened on those respective visits?
lines.zh: 而每一次又都发生了什么？

lines.en: Can we truly surmise that this is the first of all of them?
lines.zh: 我们真能断定这就是所有当中的第一次吗？

lines.en: One more deviation in an incessantly deviating timeline doesn’t seem so far fetched now, does it?
lines.zh: 在一条不断偏离的时间线上，再多一次偏离，好像也没那么离谱了，不是吗？

lines.en: Please forgive me.
lines.zh: 请原谅我。

lines.en: I get lost in thought during times like these.
lines.zh: 这种时候我总会陷入沉思。

lines.en: I’d like to take a moment and blame it on the mixture of temperatures.
lines.zh: 请允许我把这归咎于冷热的交织。

lines.en: I don’t get goosebumps the same way this girl does, but I {i}do{/i} see the beauty in life when it so rarely shows up on a silver platter.
lines.zh: 我不像这个女孩那样容易起鸡皮疙瘩，但当生命难得地主动送上银盘时，我{i}确实{/i}看得见它的美。

lines.en: And even though the girl in front of us doesn’t see things the same way I do-
lines.zh: 而尽管我们眼前的这个女孩看事物的方式跟我不一样——

lines.en: She does see things.
lines.zh: 她确实看得见。

lines.en: She sees a world much brighter than us.
lines.zh: 她看到的世界比我们明亮得多。

lines.en: A world where even those who are lost in the dark are able to crawl out as long as they persist and shed a little blood.
lines.zh: 在那个世界里，即便是迷失在黑暗中的人，只要坚持、流点血，也能爬出来。

lines.en: Bleed, you beautiful girl.
lines.zh: 流血吧，你这美丽的女孩。

lines.en: Bleed and feel alive.
lines.zh: 流血吧，去感受自己活着。

lines.en: Bleed and remind yourself that you are loved-
lines.zh: 流血吧，提醒自己你是被爱着的——

lines.en: Even though everyone else you’ve ever loved has already left you.
lines.zh: 尽管你爱过的其他人都已离你而去。

lines.en: : Is this spot taken?
lines.zh: : 这个位置有人吗？

lines.en: scene chikaonsen2
: Oh, Tsubasa! I didn’t realize you were-
lines.zh: : 哦，Tsubasa！我不知道你也——

lines.en: scene chikaonsen3
: Woah.
: Hm?
: You’re uhh...pretty stacked.
lines.zh: : 你那个……身材真不错。

lines.en: : Just try not to stare too much or you’ll go blind.
lines.zh: : 尽量别盯着看太久，不然会瞎的。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen4
: Oh, sorry! Just...took me by surprise there.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉！只是……有点被惊到了。

lines.en: : You’re like, super beautiful.
lines.zh: : 你真的，超级漂亮。

lines.en: : Is that a weird thing to say when we're both totally naked and sitting next to each other in a hot spring?
lines.zh: : 我们俩都光着身子并排坐在温泉里的时候说这种话，会不会有点怪？

lines.en: : Not at all. In fact, I’m flattered.
lines.zh: : 不怪。其实我挺受宠若惊的。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen5
: Unfortunately, I’m married. So I can’t exactly reciprocate your feelings, dear.
lines.zh: : 可惜我结婚了。所以没法回应你的心意，亲爱的。

lines.en: : I also can’t imagine your boyfriend would be very fond of you abandoning him on your getaway for someone like me.
lines.zh: : 而且我想你男朋友也不会乐意你在度假时抛下他、跑来陪我这样的人。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen6
: Oh, he’s not my boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 哦，他不是我男朋友。

lines.en: : Though...I did accidentally call him that in[school] the other day. Which was like, super embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 不过……我前几天在[学校]不小心这么叫过他。那真的超尴尬。

lines.en: : Embarrassing why?
lines.zh: : 为什么尴尬？

lines.en: : Are you ashamed of him for some reason?
lines.zh: : 你是因为什么觉得他丢人吗？

lines.en: : No, no. Not at all. But like, he’s still my teacher and there’s a pretty huge age gap between the two of us.
lines.zh: : 不不。完全不是。但毕竟他还是我的老师，而且我们俩之间年龄差挺大的。

lines.en: : So I’ve gotta try like, really really hard to not be clingy when all I wanna do is just hold his hand all day every day.
lines.zh: : 所以我得特别特别努力地克制自己别粘人，尽管我只想整天整夜牵着他的手。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen7
: Ahh, yes. Being [young]and in love.
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊。[年轻]又坠入爱河。

lines.en: : I wish I could have experienced something like that at least once in my life.
lines.zh: : 真希望我这辈子也能至少体验一次那样的感觉。

lines.en: : Treasure it while you can, dear.
lines.zh: : 趁还来得及，好好珍惜吧，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Before you know it, you’ll be old and raising kids...thinking to yourself, “Where did all the time go?”
lines.zh: : 不知不觉间，你就会老去、生儿育女……然后问自己，「那些时间都去哪了」

lines.en: scene chikaonsen8
: Wait, aren’t you married?
lines.zh: : 等等，你不是结婚了吗？

lines.en: : Do you not love your husband, Tsubasa?
lines.zh: : 你不爱你丈夫吗，Tsubasa？

lines.en: : Can you keep the answer to that question a secret?
lines.zh: : 那个问题的答案，你能保密吗？

lines.en: : Of course. Who would I even tell?
lines.zh: : 当然能。我又能告诉谁呢？

lines.en: : For all I know, you could be a spy he sent here for this exact reason.
lines.zh: : 说不定你就是他专门派来问这个的间谍呢。

lines.en: : Though I doubt a spy would have stared so blatantly at my breasts for as long as you did.
lines.zh: : 不过我猜间谍可不会像你刚才那样明目张胆地盯着我的胸看那么久。

lines.en: : I could be a really perverted spy. You never know.
lines.zh: : 我也可能是个特别好色的间谍。这说不准的。

lines.en: : I suppose that’s true. But I also suppose that even if you are a spy, hiding the truth from you wouldn’t do much this far into life.
lines.zh: : 我想也是。不过我还想，就算你是间谍，活到这个岁数，对你隐瞒真相也没什么用了。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen9
: My husband is...a good man.
lines.zh: : 我丈夫……是个好人。

lines.en: : But he’s not a man I chose for myself.
lines.zh: : 但他不是我自己选的男人。

lines.en: : I do love him, but...I don’t think I’ve ever been {i}in{/i} love with him.
lines.zh: : 我确实爱他，但……我想我从没真正{i}恋爱般地{/i}爱过他。

lines.en: : We both come from wealthy families and our marriage was arranged from the moment we were born.
lines.zh: : 我们都出身富裕家庭，我们的婚姻从出生那一刻起就被安排好了。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen10
: And between you and me, he can {i}not{/i} perform. Like, at all.
lines.zh: : 而且跟你说句实话，他{i}不行{/i}。完全不行。

lines.en: : I...don’t really know what I’m supposed to say to that.
lines.zh: : 我……真不知道这话该怎么接。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen11
: Have you and your not-boyfriend made it that far yet, dear?
lines.zh: : 那你和你那位「不是男朋友」发展到那一步了吗，亲爱的？

lines.en: : We’ve done other stuff but...haven’t gone {i}all{/i} the way yet.
lines.zh: : 我们做过别的事……但还没走到{i}最后一步{/i}。

lines.en: : We were kind of about to, but then my heart started going crazy and I wanted to take a minute or...thirty to prepare myself.
lines.zh: : 我们本来差点就要了，但我心跳得厉害，想先花一分钟……或者三十分钟来准备一下。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen12
: Oh! This means I’ll get to be around for your first time! Splendid!
lines.zh: : 哦！那说明我能赶上你的第一次！太好了！

lines.en: : If you wind up wanting someone to talk to afterward, come over to my room. I’d love to hear all about it! Tsukasa and I are in #3.
lines.zh: : 要是事后你想找人聊聊，就来我房间。我很想听听全过程！我和 Tsukasa 在 3 号房。

lines.en: : You want to...hear all about my first time?
lines.zh: : 你想……听我讲我的第一次？

lines.en: : Of course! In vivid detail!
lines.zh: : 当然！要绘声绘色地讲！

lines.en: : Tsubasa...are you actually a deviant?
lines.zh: : Tsubasa……你其实是个变态吗？

lines.en: scene chikaonsen13
: What? No. Of course not. I just-
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。当然不是。我只是——

lines.en: : Don’t normal girls like talking about things like that?
lines.zh: : 普通女孩不都喜欢聊这种事吗？

lines.en: : I mean...not in {i}detail{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我是说……不会讲得那么{i}细{/i}。

lines.en: : Oh dear. It seems I’ve said something horribly inappropriate then.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。看来我说了什么特别不得体的话。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen14
: Pfft! It’s fine. No need to get all apologetic about it.
lines.zh: : 噗！没事的。不用这么道歉。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen15
: I’ll probably wind up spending the rest of the night with my not-boyfriend afterward, but I’ll definitely come visit if something changes.
lines.zh: : 不过之后我大概会跟我的「不是男朋友」度过这一夜剩下的时间，要是有变我一定来找你。

lines.en: : So you’ve decided to follow through after all? It’s not an invasion of privacy for me to ask that much, is it?
lines.zh: : 所以你还是决定做了？我问到这份上不算侵犯隐私吧？

lines.en: : Nah, you’re fine.
lines.zh: : 没事的。

lines.en: : And yeah. I’m gonna do it.
lines.zh: : 而且是的。我要做了。

lines.en: : I love him, so-
lines.zh: : 我爱他，所以——

lines.en: : Do what?
lines.zh: : 做什么？

lines.en: scene chikaonsen16
: What are you going to do with the man you love, Miss? He looks too old for you.
lines.zh: : 你要跟你爱的那个男人做什么呀，小姐？他看着比你大多了。

lines.en: : Oh...Tsukasa. You’re here too...
lines.zh: : 哦……Tsukasa。你也在这儿……

lines.en: : Tsukasa. Chika and I are talking about {i}adult{/i} matters right now. It’s not something you should be listening in on, dear.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa。我和 Chika 正在聊{i}大人{/i}的事。这不是你该偷听的，亲爱的。

lines.en: : I can listen. I’m an adult. Please, carry on.
lines.zh: : 我能听。我是大人了。请继续。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen17
: I mean...I guess it’s fine as long as we leave out all the...explicit language, right?
lines.zh: : 我是说……只要我们避开那些……露骨的字眼，应该也没事吧？

lines.en: : Whatever you’re more comfortable with, dear.
lines.zh: : 怎么舒服怎么来，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Even if it’s just talking about love in general, feel free to vent.
lines.zh: : 哪怕只是泛泛地聊聊爱情，也尽管倾诉。

lines.en: : Being a mother is a full-time job for me, so I like to think I’m a pretty good listener.
lines.zh: : 当母亲是我的全职工作，所以我自认是个很好的倾听者。

lines.en: : Not that I think your mother has done a poor job, of course. She must be truly wonderful if she’s managed to raise a girl like you.
lines.zh: : 当然，我不是说你母亲做得不好。她一定非常出色，才能把你们这样的女孩养大。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen18
: Mhm.
: She did great.
lines.zh: : 她做得很好。

lines.en: : Oh dear...
lines.zh: : 哎呀……

lines.en: : I’ve said something insensitive again...
lines.zh: : 我又说了不该说的……

lines.en: : What happened to your mother, Miss?
lines.zh: : 你妈妈怎么了，小姐？

lines.en: scene chikaonsen19
: Tsukasa!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa！

lines.en: : She’s not around anymore.
lines.zh: : 她已经不在了。

lines.en: : So your father takes care of you all by himself?
lines.zh: : 那是你爸爸一个人照顾你吗？

lines.en: : He’s...not around either.
lines.zh: : 他……也不在了。

lines.en: : Tsukasa! Leave the two of us alone and I’ll have your father buy you anything you want!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa！别打扰我们俩，回头我让你爸爸给你买什么都行！

lines.en: : If your mother and father are both gone, who takes care of you? Your butler?
lines.zh: : 你爸爸妈妈都不在了，那谁照顾你？你的管家吗？

lines.en: : I take care of myself. I’m craaaaazy strong. Like a superhero.
lines.zh: : 我自己照顾自己。我超——————强的。像超级英雄一样。

lines.en: : Superheroes don’t exist. You should be old enough to understand that.
lines.zh: : 超级英雄不存在的。你也该懂事了。

lines.en: : Heheh~ Yeah, I guess I should.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～嗯，我想也是。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen20
: I do agree that you’re really strong, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我同意你真的很坚强。

lines.en: : If {i}I{/i} had to take care of myself, I’d eat nothing but candy. And Papa always says that candy makes you fat and ugly.
lines.zh: : 要是{i}我自己{/i}照顾自己，我肯定会只吃糖。而爸爸总说吃糖会让人变胖变丑。

lines.en: : And you’re not fat and ugly at all, Miss. You’re almost as pretty as I am and I still have both of my parents!
lines.zh: : 可小姐你一点都不胖不丑。你几乎跟我一样漂亮，而且我爸爸妈妈都还健在呢！

lines.en: scene chikaonsen21
: Tsukasa! This is your final warning!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa！这是最后一次警告！

lines.en: : Leave the two of us alone or we’ll be going home {i}tonight{/i} instead of tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 别打扰我们俩，不然我们{i}今晚{/i}就回家，不住到明天了！

lines.en: : Eek! Mother is angry!
lines.zh: : 噫！妈妈生气了！

lines.en: : It was nice talking to you, Miss!
lines.zh: : 跟您聊天很开心，小姐！

lines.en: : Have fun doing things I’m not old enough to talk about!
lines.zh: : 祝您玩得开心，做那些我还没到年纪谈论的事！

lines.en: scene chikaonsen22
The youngest of the three leaps out of the water and heads back to her room, leaving the concerned mother alone with a makeshift orphan.
lines.zh: 三人中最小的那个跃出水面，回房间去了，留下忧心忡忡的母亲，跟一个临时孤儿独处。

lines.en: They bleed together.
lines.zh: 她们一起流着血。

lines.en: : I am...so sorry for her behavior.
lines.zh: : 真是……太抱歉她这样了。

lines.en: : She’s been a total troublemaker ever since she was born. I can’t even tell you how many of our maids have quit because of her.
lines.zh: : 她打从生下来就是个惹祸精。我都说不清有多少女仆因为她辞职了。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen23
: It’s fine. Really. It’s my fault for tearing up anyway.
lines.zh: : 没事的。真的。是我自己掉眼泪的错。

lines.en: : This is supposed to be a getaway, not some place for me to bawl my eyes out in front of somebody else’s mom.
lines.zh: : 这本来是来度假的，不是让我在别人妈妈面前哭得稀里哗啦的地方。

lines.en: : Thanks for even taking the time to talk to me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你肯花时间跟我说话。

lines.en: : It helps.
lines.zh: : 真的很有帮助。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen24
: You don’t have to thank me at all, dear. It’s my pleasure.
lines.zh: : 你完全不用谢我，亲爱的。这是我的荣幸。

lines.en: : I’ll be more considerate in the future before saying things like that.
lines.zh: : 以后说这种话之前我会更注意的。

lines.en: : Now...back to the topic of love.
lines.zh: : 那么……回到爱这个话题。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen25
: You’re really excited to talk about all this love stuff, huh?
lines.zh: : 你聊起这些爱的话题可真来劲啊？

lines.en: : Can you blame me for wanting to hear about something I was never able to experience on my own?
lines.zh: : 我从来没机会亲身体验，想听听也情有可原吧？

lines.en: : Course not. I’m just not really sure where to start since my experience with “love” is just as limited as my experience with...the other thing.
lines.zh: : 当然不怪。我只是不知道从哪儿说起，因为我对「爱」的经验，跟对……那档子事的经验一样有限。

lines.en: : Like, I didn’t even receive my first confession until a few months ago.
lines.zh: : 比如，我几个月前才收到人生第一次告白。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen26
: Your teacher confessed?! Chika, that’s wonderful!
lines.zh: : 你老师跟你告白了？！Chika，那太好了！

lines.en: : What are you waiting for?! Get back to your room and-
lines.zh: : 你还等什么？！快回你房间去——

lines.en: : It was...actually a girl.
lines.zh: : 其实……是个女孩。

lines.en: : A girl confessed to me.
lines.zh: : 一个女孩跟我告白了。

lines.en: : One of my friends.
lines.zh: : 我的一个朋友。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen27
: Perhaps I’m just too old to talk to [young]people anymore.
lines.zh: : 也许我真是太老了，不适合跟[年轻]人聊天了。

lines.en: : I’m making far too many mistakes for just one conversation.
lines.zh: : 一段对话里我犯的错太多了。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen28
: You don’t have to blame yourself for that one. The way I said it was kind of misleading, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那个你不用自责。是我说的方式有点误导人吧。

lines.en: : I’m actually really glad you asked since I...haven’t really had anyone to talk about it with.
lines.zh: : 我其实挺高兴你问的，因为我……一直没处说这事。

lines.en: : Well...if you’re fine with me continuing to make things horrible...
lines.zh: : 那……要是你不介意我继续把事情搞砸的话……

lines.en: : You’re not making anything horrible. This is actually really fun.
lines.zh: : 你没搞砸任何事。这其实挺有意思的。

lines.en: : So...this {i}girl{/i} then...you said she was a friend of yours?
lines.zh: : 那……这个{i}女孩{/i}……你说是你朋友？

lines.en: : Yeah. We’ve known each other since middle[school].
lines.zh: : 嗯。我们从[中学]就认识了。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen29
: She’s really nice and super funny, but in like a...“not trying to be funny” sort of way.
lines.zh: : 她人特别好，也特别逗，不过是那种……「没在刻意搞笑」的逗。

lines.en: : Like she’s a total nerd who talks way too much and makes herself look like an idiot and you kinda just wanna...hug her and pat her head.
lines.zh: : 她是个十足的书呆子，话特别多，老把自己弄得像个傻瓜，让你有点想……抱住她、摸摸她的头。

lines.en: : And she’s sooo pretty and like, doesn’t even realize it. It’s actually kind of annoying.
lines.zh: : 而且她超————漂亮，自己却完全没意识到。这还挺让人恼火的。

lines.en: : But it’s not all good stuff. She has her problems too.
lines.zh: : 但也不全是好的。她也有自己的问题。

lines.en: : I mean, we all have our problems I guess. But hers just seem to come out of nowhere, so she can never even prepare for them.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我们大家都有问题。但她的那些好像总是毫无预兆地冒出来，她根本没法准备。

lines.en: : I don’t know if she knows that {i}I{/i} know that. But it’s kind of hard to not pick up on somebody’s tics after being around them for so long.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}不知道她知不知道我看出来了。但跟一个人相处久了，很难不察觉她的小动作。

lines.en: : It seems to me like you really like this girl.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来，你是真喜欢这个女孩。

lines.en: : I do. She’s amazing.
lines.zh: : 是的。她很棒。

lines.en: : And if she told me about it sooner, before I met the guy I’m here with today...
lines.zh: : 而要是她早点告诉我——在我遇到今天跟我来的这个男人之前……

lines.en: : I probably would have given it a shot.
lines.zh: : 我多半会跟她试试。

lines.en: : And this “guy.” Sensei? Is he aware of this?
lines.zh: : 那这位「男人」。Sensei？他知道这事吗？

lines.en: : Maybe?
lines.zh: : 也许吧？

lines.en: : Probably?
lines.zh: : 大概吧？

lines.en: scene chikaonsen30
: I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : I’d kind of prefer him to not get involved since it’s between her and me.
lines.zh: : 我有点希望他别掺和，因为这是我和她之间的事。

lines.en: : If he knows, he knows. But it’s not like I’m going to vent to him about it when it will only make things more confusing than they already are.
lines.zh: : 他要知道就知道吧。但我也不会跟他倒这事，因为只会让本来就乱的事更乱。

lines.en: : There are...a {i}lot{/i} of girls who seem to like him just as much as I do.
lines.zh: : 好像……有{i}好多{/i}女孩跟我一样喜欢他。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen31
: And I’m secretly a bitch, so I want to keep all of them as far away as possible.
lines.zh: : 而我暗地里是个贱人，所以我想让她们全都离他远远的。

lines.en: : It’s better that things stay simple.
lines.zh: : 事情简单点比较好。

lines.en: : He’s not the type who likes drama so, if I can, I’m gonna avoid drudging it up by all means necessary.
lines.zh: : 他不是喜欢狗血戏码的人，所以能避免的话，我会想尽办法不去挑事。

lines.en: : He’s like, really protective of the other girl, so I don’t want to risk him trying to get the two of us together or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 他对另一个女孩特别保护，所以我不想冒险让他撮合我们俩什么的。

lines.en: : The more he thinks of me, the better. You know?
lines.zh: : 他越多想着我就越好。你懂吧？

lines.en: scene chikaonsen32
: You really do love him, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是真的很爱他，对吧？

lines.en: : Sooooo much. Like, a gross amount of love.
lines.zh: : 超——————爱。爱到有点恶心的程度。

lines.en: : Have you told him yet?
lines.zh: : 你跟他说过了吗？

lines.en: scene chikaonsen33
: Told him what? That I love him?
lines.zh: : 说什么？说我爱他？

lines.en: : No...I mean...
lines.zh: : 没……我是说……

lines.en: : I mean, he probably already knows.
lines.zh: : 我是说，他多半已经知道了。

lines.en: : Right?
lines.zh: : 对吧？

lines.en: : He’s a man. He won’t know unless you tell him.
lines.zh: : 他是男人。你不说，他是不会知道的。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Tsubasa. I feel like I make it pretty damn obvious.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Tsubasa。我觉得我表现得已经够明显的了。

lines.en: : Well...here’s a new question, then.
lines.zh: : 那……换个新问题。

lines.en: : What are you waiting for?
lines.zh: : 你还在等什么？

lines.en: : You want to keep those other girls away from him, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你不是想让别的女孩离他远点吗？

lines.en: : Wouldn’t telling him you love him help with that?
lines.zh: : 那你告诉他你爱他，不就能帮上忙了？

lines.en: : I feel like it could go either way.
lines.zh: : 我觉得两种可能都有。

lines.en: : Like, he’d either be really happy to hear it or he’d think I was moving too fast and try to distance himself from me.
lines.zh: : 要么他听了会很高兴，要么他会觉得我进展太快，想跟我拉开距离。

lines.en: : Forgive me if this is one more thing I’m not fully comprehending due to lack of experience but-
lines.zh: : 请原谅我经验不足又问了个可能不太懂的事——

lines.en: : Do you really think you’d fall in love with someone who would run away after hearing that?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得你会爱上一个听到告白就跑掉的人吗？

lines.en: : Have some more faith in yourself. You’re a bright, beautiful [young_girl] with a great future ahead of you.
lines.zh: : 多给自己点信心。你是个聪明、美丽的[年轻女孩]，前途一片光明。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen34
: Tsubasa...
lines.zh: : Tsubasa……

lines.en: : I really don’t know how to thank you for all of this.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道该怎么谢你这些。

lines.en: : I’ve never been able to talk about stuff like this with anyone before...and that advice was like, exactly what I needed.
lines.zh: : 我以前从没跟谁聊过这种事……而你刚才的建议，正是我需要的。

lines.en: : You don’t need to thank me at all, dear.
lines.zh: : 你完全不用谢我，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Just go back to your room and give the man you love that WAP.
lines.zh: : 回你房间去，把那个 WAP 给你爱的男人吧。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，什么？

lines.en: scene chikaonsen35
: Did I not use that term correctly?
lines.zh: : 我用词没用对吗？

lines.en: : I often turn on the radio when I have time to myself. And I’ve been hearing that word thrown around by [young]people in sexual contexts.
lines.zh: : 我一个人没事的时候常开收音机。老听到[年轻]人在性的语境里用这个词。

lines.en: : That’s...
: I mean...you’re not {i}wrong{/i}...it was just a really weird time to say that...
lines.zh: : 我是说……你没用{i}错{/i}……只是这时候说这个词真的好怪……

lines.en: : I...I’m not sure how I feel about it.
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道该作何感想。

lines.en: scene chikaonsen34
: Well, whatever the case...I think we both know you’ve overstayed your welcome here.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管怎样……我想我们都清楚，你在这儿泡得够久了。

lines.en: : The poor man is probably still up there waiting for you.
lines.zh: : 那可怜的男人多半还在上面等你。

lines.en: : And, I’m sorry if this suggestion is insensitive-
lines.zh: : 还有，要是我这个建议太冒昧，抱歉——

lines.en: : But if you wind up being too scared to follow through-
lines.zh: : 但要是你到时候又太害怕不敢做——

lines.en: scene chikaonsen36
: Or perhaps you just want to talk to a mother-
lines.zh: : 或者你只是想找个妈妈聊聊——

lines.en: : You know where to find me.
lines.zh: : 你知道去哪儿找我。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Probably sounds weird and corny, but like...I kinda feel like fate brought the two of us together today.
lines.zh: : 听着可能有点怪有点俗，但我真觉得今天是命运把我们俩凑到一起的。

lines.en: : I try my best but...not having my mom around to talk about stuff like this with can be really overwhelming.
lines.zh: : 我已经很努力了……但身边没有妈妈可以聊这种事，真的压得我喘不过气。

lines.en: : So hearing from you that I’m not just rushing into things is...
lines.zh: : 所以听你说我不是在仓促行事……

lines.en: : It’s a big help.
lines.zh: : 真的帮了我大忙。

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你。

lines.en: : I don’t know much about fate, but I {i}do{/i} know that I’m happy to have helped you.
lines.zh: : 我不太懂什么命运，但我{i}知道{/i}能帮到你我很开心。

lines.en: : It’s okay to be scared. And it’s okay to worry about things like this.
lines.zh: : 害怕没关系。为这种事担心也没关系。

lines.en: : But if {i}you{/i} think you’re ready for your first time...and {i}you{/i} think you’re ready to tell the WAP man you love him-
lines.zh: : 但如果{i}你{/i}觉得你的第一次准备好了……也觉得准备好跟那个 WAP 男说你爱他了——

lines.en: : Please don’t call him the WAP man, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 求你别叫他 WAP 男，Tsubasa。

lines.en: : Then all you need to do is follow your heart.
lines.zh: : 那你唯一要做的就是跟随你的心。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Yeah. I think this bath has gone on for long enough.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我觉得这澡泡得够久了。

lines.en: : Are you getting out, too?
lines.zh: : 你也要出去了吗？

lines.en: : Oh, heavens no. The longer I can relax and not have to deal with Tsukasa, the better.
lines.zh: : 哦，才不呢。我能多放松一会儿、不用应付 Tsukasa，就再好不过了。

lines.en: : Good luck, though.
lines.zh: : 不过祝你好运。

lines.en: : I’ll be here if you need anything.
lines.zh: : 有事就来找我。

lines.en: scene black
Sometimes, bleeding freely {i}isn’t{/i} ideal.
lines.zh: 有时候，肆意流血并{i}不{/i}理想。

lines.en: Sometimes, it’s better to have someone there beside you, holding your wound closed and making sure bacteria doesn’t find its way in.
lines.zh: 有时候，最好有个人在你身边，替你按住伤口，不让细菌侵进去。

lines.en: Someone to apply a tourniquet.
lines.zh: 一个为你系上止血带的人。

lines.en: Relying on people like that is fine if you find yourself caught in a pinch.
lines.zh: 陷入困境时，依靠这样的人没什么不好。

lines.en: Does it make you stronger? No.
lines.zh: 这会让你更强大吗？不会。

lines.en: But it doesn’t make you weaker either.
lines.zh: 但也不会让你更软弱。

lines.en: Be happy!
lines.zh: 快乐起来吧！

lines.en: Find your place in the world!
lines.zh: 找到你在这世上的位置！

lines.en: And if one does not exist, create your own!
lines.zh: 如果没有，就自己创造一个！

lines.en: Just know-
lines.zh: 只是要知道——

lines.en: That even if everything goes according to plan-
lines.zh: 就算一切按计划进行——

lines.en: And all of the puzzle pieces in all of your world fit into place-
lines.zh: 你世界里所有的拼图都各就各位——

lines.en: You will still bleed.
lines.zh: 你也依然会流血。

lines.en: {i}Chika has acquired a new mother!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 获得了一位新妈妈！{/i}
